spans.s:
__1 A ram, sheep. 
__2 The sign Aries of the zodiac. 
-Comp. 
-अण्डः an epithet of Indra. 
-कम्बलः a woollen blanket or rug. 
-कुसुमः, -लोचनः Cassia Thora (Mar. टाकळा). 
-पालः, -पालकः a shepherd. 
-मांसम् mutton. 
-यूथम् a flock of sheep. 
-शृङ्गः a species of tree; [[
Den. Ā. To act like a ram.
N. of the 10th astrological house. [A Greek word]; [[Bṛ. S.]]
